# What the Linux arm64 bundle must have. One "kind name" per line.
#   configure / refuse-configure   an option FFmpeg is built with / must not be built with
#   decoder encoder demuxer muxer filter protocol bsf hwaccel   a name FFmpeg must list
#   option <where> <name>          an option that "ffmpeg -h <where>" must show
# The names come from what server-next calls and from the hardware the owner asked for.
# Against the x86 list: no Intel Quick Sync and no AMD AMF, which exist only on x86.

refuse-configure --enable-nonfree
refuse-configure --enable-libfdk-aac
# Rockchip's libraries are left out until rkrga's licence file has been read and there is a
# board to try them on; a Rockchip board converts in software meanwhile.
refuse-configure --enable-rkmpp
refuse-configure --enable-rkrga

# Libraries
configure --enable-libass
